Semicircle described on MN as diameter; R is the intersection of the perpendicular from O with the semicircle
MR and RN are joined, forming triangle MRN inscribed in the semicircle
Angle MRN is a right angle since R lies on semicircle with diameter MN (3.31)
sq(MR) + sq(RN) = sq(MN) by Pythagorean theorem (1.47)
RO is perpendicular to MN from point R on semicircle, creating similar triangles MRO, RNO, MRN (6.8)
sq(MR) = rect(MN, MO) and sq(RN) = rect(MN, ON) from similar triangles
sq(RO) = rect(MO, ON) from altitude-to-hypotenuse relation (6.8)
MR * RN = MN * RO from equal areas of triangle MRN computed two ways
